authorization_interpretation: Explicitly open the already-frozen exact-400 B06 event targets and run one frozen World Model V2 retrospective scientific evaluation.

frozen_v2.estimand: Holding frozen rolling-xG fixture marginal means fixed, test explicit bivariate-Poisson shared-score dependence versus independent Poisson.
frozen_v2.split: 45% chronological burn-in by whole date groups; remaining test; 3 contiguous chronological date folds; all same-date predictions frozen before same-date event update

b06_adapter.allowed_change: Data-entry adapter only. Load exactly the frozen 400 B06 provider identities and recover match date/team metadata without using score fields; reuse the frozen V2 marginal estimator, theta fit, probability code, split, metrics and gates byte-for-byte.
b06_adapter.multi_competition_policy: Do not introduce competition-specific priors, weights, recalibration, covariates or retuning. The original globally pooled rolling-xG marginal family remains unchanged. Interpret this as a heterogeneous-domain robustness/development test of the joint-dependence mechanism.
b06_adapter.event_target_policy: After all code and this contract are frozen, StatsBomb event payloads may be GET. Realized goals and xG are derived from event streams. Same-date predictions must be frozen before any same-date event updates history.

result_policy.after_run: Freeze result. B06 labels become VIEWED and must not be reused for retuning followed by an independent-test claim.
